title: Ironhollow Rising Revisited
premise: August Zhou's gift for hearing the dead has kept her guild solvent for years, but when the crown declares a hunt for the gifted, her ledgers become evidence and her allies become informants. Fleeing with a disgraced royal cartographer, Wren, she discovers the hunt is a cover for the crown's plan to sever the covenant between the living realm and Ironhollow, the land of the dead, and harvest its power. To stop it, August must reforge the broken covenant by offering something irreplaceable: her own voice among the living. In the end she chooses to speak the binding words, trading her place in the world of breath for a new one as bridge between realms — alive, but forever half-heard.
about_author: S. M. Marchetti is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing estate inventories and now writes fantasy about people who keep impossible accounts. They live near a river that floods every spring, which they insist is not an omen.

chapters.title: The Ledger of Small Debts
chapters.summary: August Zhou balances the guild's books while listening to the dead whisper through carved bone tokens, hiding her gift behind meticulous bookkeeping. When a royal auditor arrives demanding names of the gifted, August burns a page and lies for the first time in her career. POV: August. Emotional beat: quiet dread beneath routine — the moment survival requires betrayal.

chapters.title: What the Bones Owe
chapters.summary: The guildmaster sells a gifted apprentice's name to save the guild, and the girl vanishes into the crown's custody. August hears the apprentice's ghost arrive at her workbench, furious and afraid. She decides to run, taking the covenant ledger — the record of the old pact between realms. POV: August. Emotional beat: guilt curdling into resolve.

chapters.title: A Cartographer's Error
chapters.summary: August flees into the marsh country and collides with Wren, a disgraced royal mapmaker whose maps deliberately omit the roads to Ironhollow. Hunted together, they strike a wary bargain: his knowledge of the crown's routes for her covenant lore. POV: alternating August and Wren. Emotional beat: two liars recognizing each other.

chapters.title: The Toll Road
chapters.summary: Traveling a road that charges memory instead of coin, August pays with recollections of her mother while Wren confesses he once mapped the hunt's prison-fortresses. The dead on the road warn them: the covenant isn't broken — it's being eaten. POV: Wren. Emotional beat: intimacy forged through mutual loss.

chapters.title: Ironhollow, Half-Heard
chapters.summary: They reach the border where the dead realm bleeds through: rusted bells, bone orchards, voices like weather. August learns the covenant demands a speaker willing to bind both realms with their own voice — and that the last speaker died badly. POV: August. Emotional beat: awe shadowed by the cost coming into focus.

chapters.title: The Crown's Arithmetic
chapters.summary: Captured by the hunt and brought before the queen's minister, August discovers the truth: caging the gifted feeds their voices to the crown's engine, which is devouring the covenant strand by strand. The imprisoned apprentice is alive — barely. POV: Wren. Emotional beat: horror at how neatly duty has been weaponized.

chapters.title: Ledger Closed, Ledger Open
chapters.summary: August bargains with the guildmaster one last time, trading the covenant ledger for the keys to the prison carts, then frees the captured gifted — including the apprentice, who refuses to forgive her. POV: August. Emotional beat: love against duty; some debts can be paid but not repaired.

chapters.title: The Bells Remember
chapters.summary: The freed gifted join August at the border as the crown's engine arrives, dragging severed covenant-threads behind it like harpoons. Wren chooses to stand with her, burning his final loyalty to the crown. The dead begin to sing through every bell in Ironhollow. POV: alternating. Emotional beat: fragile alliance becoming a chorus.

chapters.title: The Binding Word
chapters.summary: Climax. At the covenant's heart, August speaks the binding words, offering her voice to weld the realms together as the minister's engine tears at the seam. The dead lend her their borrowed voices; the engine shatters; the minister is pulled into the silence he made. POV: August. Emotional beat: sacrifice transfigured into purpose.

chapters.title: Half-Heard, Whole
chapters.summary: Resolution. The hunt dissolves; the gifted are free; Wren maps the new border honestly at last. August remains between realms — alive but faint, heard only when someone truly listens. Wren learns to listen. POV: Wren, closing on August's voice arriving clear as a bell. Emotional beat: grief and love reconciled; survival's price made bearable by company.
